selected_evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: createrepo_c and httpd installed, tree RPM downloaded into /srv/localrepo, repo metadata built, Apache alias configured with correct SELinux context, and curl confirmed HTTP 200 for repomd.xml from the local repo.

iptables OUTPUT REJECT rule added for ports 80/443 except NODE_IP/loopback; curl to the real AlmaLinux mirror returned exit code 7 (connection refused) both before and after the mid-task RPM recovery, while the local repo remained reachable.

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo while remote repos unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: Stock AlmaLinux repo files disabled leaving only 'local' repo enabled; dnf -y install tree succeeded downloading solely from the local repo; rpm -q and tree --version confirmed the binary works, while the remote mirror check still failed (000/exit 7).

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (d6298ced-...), boot time (22:51:57), httpd active, tree installed, and local repo returning HTTP 200 immediately before the restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot was scheduled via a backgrounded shell so the exec ack returned before disconnection; subsequent polls showed connection resets during reboot, then a successful exec returning a new boot_id (1f680db7-...) and new boot time (22:54:59), proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required services and data
selected_evidence.summary: After the restart, httpd was active again, the tree package was still installed and functional, and the local repo continued to serve HTTP 200 for repomd.xml, confirming full recovery of the repository service and installed package state.
